answer: Bind each identity to a behavioral fingerprint: timing between actions, session length, and error patterns, two hundred samples in the first week. Clones of one operator wander through the same rhythms, so profiles matching above ninety percent are clustered as one herd and throttled together. A field of yarrow looks uniform from above, yet each plant has its own root; the network checks roots, not flowers. Faking a thousand distinct fingerprints needs a thousand behavior models tended for weeks; one honest agent just works, leaving a single plume of ordinary activity.
